next_actions: Use these recordings as the baseline; do not spend further supervised time repeating the same unmodified clip without a specific comparison.

Before another generated-motion optimization, reproduce the observed rear-joint reduced amplitude in an offline model that includes the verified driver absolute limits and relevant contact/actuation behavior; current nominal simulation underestimates reference error.

Select one explicit objective before changing a policy/reference/controller: clearer visible motion, lower command variation, or lower joint/reference error. The prior2rad/s slew candidate reduced command steps but did not consistently improve simulated joint-frequency metrics, so it remains unpromoted.

If a changed candidate becomes evidence-supported, compare the original and one candidate at unchanged gains/limits in a separately supervised block. Validate actual motion quality with the operator; do not infer acceptance from these metrics alone.
limitations: Two new physical trials, only one watched; old/new sessions were not controlled for battery, surface, temperature, starting pose or perturbations. No causal or population robustness conclusion.

Headerless observation/actor/controller-target streams are independently published and matched by recorder receive times, not embedded sequence IDs. Exact same-observation reference/q error avoids that association, but source sample time remains unknown.
Corrected driver host-receipt validity does not make ROS IMU header or logged IMU-age a true measurement/exposure timestamp. Header-time sensitivity is illustrative only.

Nominal active boundaries are controller-manager activation+0.5s initialization+1s fade through5.96s reference, capped by return; first samples can still include the very end of fade. Clip-status boundaries and raw observations are retained.
Comparative first/second differences use measured~50Hz versus simulator52Hz cadence; they are descriptive and not resampling-invariant roughness or physical jerk estimates.

Current plots and statistics contain no motor-board target/current trace, force/contact measurement or independent motion capture. They cannot distinguish contact load, actuator calibration/friction, unobserved downstream actuation effects or training-model error as the sole cause.
Actor replay checks computation on recorded inputs, not global policy optimality or hardware safety. No gains, policy or launch changed.
